text:
## Template 9: Password Reset Confirmation  
**Subject:** Your Password Has Been Reset Successfully  
```
Dear [Customer Name],

Your online banking password has been successfully reset.

Important Security Notes:
✓ Your new password is now active
✓ Your old password no longer works
✓ Log in at www.firstuk.bank/login with your new password
✓ Never share your password with anyone

If You Didn't Request This:
If you didn't reset your password, contact us immediately:
- Phone: 0800-555-2265 (24/7)
- Email: support@firstuk.bank

Security Reminder:
- Use a strong password (mix of letters, numbers, symbols)
- Change your password every 6 months
- Never reuse old passwords
- Log out after each session

Thank you,
FirstUK Bank Security Team
```
